entries.adapted_criterion: Matter enters a status carrying automations -> the configured task list is added and, if a message automation is configured, a templated email is sent to the matter's primary contact without manual action. Email is the only message channel in v1; Message Templates are owned by the deferred client-communication module, so v1 uses its own email templates.

Admin creates a custom attribute for contacts or matters -> the field is fillable on overview pages and available in custom intakes and automated templates. The reports surface is deferred with the reports module.

User opens the Firm Feed -> creations and updates of in-scope resource types (contacts, matters, forms, tasks, notes, events, files) are listed and searchable. Invoices and messages join the feed when their modules enter scope.

entries.content_note: Engine in scope, library content is not: v1 ships a schema-driven forms engine plus the 5-form starter set (see meta.starter_set). Criterion tested against the starter set: user selects a case type -> the system offers the required starter-set forms from the library. Library growth is post-v1 content work.

entries.adapted_criterion: Firm selects a supported language on an intake or its invitation -> the client sees translated question text for questions carrying translations. v1 ships the translation architecture (per-question translatable strings, language chosen at invitation, client-side re-translate) with one demonstration language pack; machine-translation service integration is post-v1 and approval-gated (external service dependency).

User with a validated questionnaire starts a package export -> the system produces a submission-ready package (completed form artifact plus structured field payload) for the eligible form with attached G-28. Actual my.uscis.gov account sync and submission are out of v1 (government accounts).
User starts a package export with an incomplete questionnaire -> a validation error list appears with per-question links and explanations, and export is blocked until re-validation passes.

entries.parked_trigger: DS-160 enters the forms library. Gate ruling (James, 2026-08-01): without its form, this entry reduces to a shared mechanism test -- spinning wheels; parked until the form forces the clarity.
DS-260 enters the forms library. Same gate ruling as ceac-ds160-efiling.
ETA-9035 or ETA-9141 enters the forms library. Same gate ruling as the CEAC entries.

entries.adapted_criterion: User selects prospective employees on an employer contact and starts an H-1B Registration -> a registration form instance is created for the employer and each selected beneficiary (bulk limited to 20). E-filing of the registrations is out of v1 (government accounts).
User toggles an N-400 e-file-package Smart Form to paper -> the form switches to the paper version without recreating the intake ('electronic version' in v1 means the e-file-package mode).

A new form edition is loaded into the library -> previously prepared forms migrate to the newer edition automatically. The vendor 5-business-day SLA is an operations commitment, outside mechanical scope.

User clicks Switch to the previous version on a form whose previous edition remains in the library -> the form reverts to the previous edition and can switch back. (Which agencies carry multiple editions is vendor history, not mechanics.)

User sends an invitation by a supported method (email or shareable link in v1) -> the contact gains secure access to complete the questionnaire. SMS is deferred with client-communication; portal sharing is deferred with client-portal.
User sets a default email invitation message in Invitation Settings -> subsequent email invitations carry that message without retyping. Text-message defaults are deferred with SMS.

User enters a Priority Date and Preference Category on a matter -> the Case Tracking tab shows current status for filing and status for final action computed against the loaded Visa Bulletin dataset. Bulletin data arrives via a replay adapter over captured Visa Bulletin data; live monthly fetch is post-v1 (external service).

A loaded Visa Bulletin update changes a tracked matter's priority date status -> the firm receives an in-app notification and the change appears in the monthly email digest. Bulletin updates are replayed from captured data.

User adds a USCIS receipt number on the Case Tracking tab -> the receipt's current case status, sourced from the replay adapter over captured USCIS responses, is displayed on the matter and its primary contact. Live USCIS querying is post-v1 (external service).
User clicks Update beside a receipt number -> the system queries the replay adapter and refreshes the stored case status if it has changed.

A tracked receipt's status changes in the adapter dataset -> the stored status updates without user action on the configured schedule. Subscription-plan frequency tiers are N/A in a single-firm deployment; check frequency is a firm setting.
A scheduled check detects a status change on a matter's receipt -> the matter's assignees receive an email and in-app notification.

User invokes preview on a supported file -> the file content displays without a download. v1 supported types: pdf, png, jpeg/jpg, txt, csv; Office formats (doc/docx/xls/xlsx) are post-v1 (conversion dependency).
User selects Email for unsigned signers and clicks Send to Unsigned -> each selected signer receives an e-signature request by email. The SMS channel is deferred.

User adds a notification to an event with a value and unit of time -> attendees receive an email reminder that far before the event's start; multiple reminders per event are supported. SMS reminders are deferred with prejudice.

entries.parked_trigger: Multi-tenancy ever enters scope (goal.md edit). Gate ruling 2 (James, 2026-08-01): firm selection by subdomain is architecture-moot under single-firm deployment; any v1 wording passes automatically.

entries.adapted_criterion: User with 2FA enabled logs in -> an OTP from the chosen method (authenticator app or email in v1) is required to complete login; an admin can reset a user's 2FA, forcing re-enrollment at next login. SMS delivery is deferred; trial-period mandatory-enrollment mechanics are N/A (no trials in a single-firm deployment).

Admin deactivates a user -> the user can no longer log in while their data and logs remain accessible; reactivation restores access. User deletion is a tombstone soft delete per the schema invariant (hard delete forbidden by goal.md), with assignment-clearing per the corpus retention rules. Subscription-license mechanics are N/A in a single-firm deployment.
